title: GTA 6 reveals its DJ lineup, radio stations, and new gameplay leaks
summary: Rockstar details the soundtrack, stations, and the ability to listen to podcasts on foot, while new leaked videos show nudity and unseen mechanics.

title: Xbox launches XP division to bring its franchises to film, television, and theme parks
summary: Microsoft creates a new transmedia unit led by Minecraft and relies on former Meta executives to monetize its IP beyond video games.

title: Cyberpunk 2077 to get live-action film produced by Call of Duty studio and Doom producer
summary: Paramount Pictures and the producer of the panned Doom film will adapt CD Projekt Red's universe into a live-action feature.

title: Ubisoft shuts down Rainbow Six Mobile and another saga game after less than a year on the market
summary: The company abandons its mobile and live-service bets after acknowledging commercial failure, mere months after global launch.

title: The Witcher 3 Remastered receives patch with visual improvements and blur fix on Switch 2
summary: The update fixes bloom issues, adds sharpness to the Nintendo Switch 2 version, and refines lighting across all platforms.

title: Dave the Diver and Subnautica 2 team up in crossover DLC allowing hunting of Nibbler Mangos
summary: Dave the Diver's studio collaborates with Unknown Worlds to integrate Subnautica 2 creatures and mechanics into a free expansion.

title: ARC Raiders 2.0 'Frozen Trail' revives player base with crucial progression changes
summary: The update introduces balance adjustments, new content, and an economy overhaul that has driven concurrency to multi-month highs.

title: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen arrives with technical improvements and confirmed release date
summary: The expansion adds endgame content, fixes performance, and launches simultaneously on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series.

title: Hellraiser: Revival divides critics over its realistic bondage club and uneven horror
summary: The new franchise entry mixes narrative exploration and puzzles with an explicit aesthetic that doesn't convince all analysts.

title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer expands multiplayer and reveals its origin as a board game with sticky notes
summary: Developers explain how they prototyped pod races with physical boards and announce that group matches will double in size soon.

title: Best Buy organizes midnight launch of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 after pre-orders sell out
summary: The US chain replicates the 1998 event for the remastered version, offering a last chance for physical purchase.

title: Forza Horizon 6 coming to PS5 in January 2027 alongside its first expansion
summary: Playground Games confirms the franchise's multiplatform debut with a concrete date and additional content from day one.

title: Phantom Blade Zero impresses press as the greatest martial arts fantasy in video games
summary: After four hours of hands-on, outlets highlight its fluid combat, art direction, and technical ambition, cementing it as one of the most anticipated action RPGs.

title: Gears of War: E-Day will be Xbox exclusive and its creators defend the decision as correct
summary: The Coalition states exclusivity allows leveraging hardware and promises the next title won't take seven years to develop.

title: Prospice: Anomalous Logistics blends logistics management and cosmic horror transporting ancient god parts
summary: The game from SnowRunner's creators swaps pipes for limbs of Lovecraftian entities in a supernatural delivery experience.

title: Blizzard redesigns Skyborne race in World of Warcraft: Forever after community complaints
summary: The studio modifies the new allied race's appearance to be less controversial, keeping its lore but softening its aesthetic.

title: NBA 2K27 surpasses Madden NFL 27 and becomes third best-selling game of 2026 in US
summary: The basketball simulator dominates August monthly charts, confirming the annual hegemony of 2K's franchise.

title: Physical sales of Marvel's Wolverine exceed a third of total despite Sony's anti-disc strategy
summary: Market data reveals strong physical demand for the PS5 exclusive, contradicting the digital trend pushed by Sony itself.
